title: Quick Test 15m - Đề 01
description: Thử thách 15 phút: 15 câu chọn lọc Part 5 (8 câu), Part 6 (4 câu), Part 7 (3 câu) rèn luyện phản xạ và tốc độ làm bài.

questions.content: All expense invoices must be submitted ------- to the accounting department for prompt reimbursement.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ bị động "must be submitted" cần một trạng từ (adverb) bổ nghĩa cho hành động nộp → chọn "promptly" (ngay lập tức, kịp thời).

questions.content: Ms. Gomez confirmed her flight ------- for the upcoming international marketing summit in Tokyo.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ "flight reservation" = việc đặt chỗ chuyến bay. Sau danh từ "flight" đóng vai trò định ngữ cần danh từ chính → "reservation".

questions.content: Mr. Henderson presented ------- quarterly sales report during the regional executive meeting.
questions.explanation: Đứng trước cụm danh từ "quarterly sales report" cần tính từ sở hữu bổ nghĩa → chọn "his" (của anh ấy).

questions.content: The outdoor ribbon-cutting ceremony was delayed ------- unexpected inclement weather in the harbor area.
questions.explanation: Theo sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ ("unexpected inclement weather") chỉ lý do → chọn giới từ "due to" (bởi vì). "Because" cần mệnh đề; "in spite" thiếu "of".

questions.content: Apex Solutions ------- a lucrative multi-year contract to modernize the city's mass transit system.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít "Apex Solutions" (tên công ty) được trao hợp đồng → dùng dạng bị động số ít thì quá khứ đơn: "was awarded".

questions.content: To maintain customer trust, the firm needs to partner with a more ------- logistics provider.
questions.explanation: Trước danh từ "logistics provider" cần tính từ mang nghĩa "đáng tin cậy" → chọn "reliable". "Reliant" mang nghĩa phụ thuộc vào ai đó.

questions.content: ------- the renovation budget was finalized late, the construction crew completed the lobby ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề đầy đủ (S + V) có ý nghĩa tương phản đối lập → chọn liên từ "Although" (Mặc dù). "Despite" cần danh từ/cụm danh từ.

questions.content: The regional director commended the hospitality team for providing consistently ------- service to guests.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "service" đứng sau và được bổ nghĩa bởi trạng từ "consistently" cần một tính từ → chọn "exceptional" (xuất sắc, đặc biệt tốt).

groups.passage:
MEMORANDUM

To: All Headquarters Staff
From: Facilities & Operations
Date: October 14
Subject: Upcoming Corporate Relocation

As previously announced, our headquarters will be relocating to the new Diamond Tower complex over the upcoming weekend. The moving process will begin on Friday at 5:00 PM and continue ---(131)--- Sunday evening.

All personnel are requested to pack their desktop computers and personal belongings into the provided crates before departing on Friday. ---(132)--- by the facilities team in the third-floor conference room starting tomorrow morning.

Please note that the new building features an automated security badge system. You ---(133)--- your new access card from the reception desk upon arrival on Monday morning. We appreciate your ---(134)--- and patience during this transition.

questions.explanation: Cụm "continue through + mốc thời gian" = tiếp diễn liên tục suốt đến tận (chủ nhật).

options: The cafeteria menu will be upgraded next month
Annual vacation requests should be submitted via the portal
Parking permits must be renewed annually by all drivers
Cardboard boxes and color-coded labels will be distributed
questions.explanation: Câu trước nhắc đến việc nhân viên đóng gói đồ đạc ("pack their desktop computers..."), do đó câu nối phù hợp nhất là phát hộp và nhãn dán.
Diễn tả hành động sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai vào sáng thứ Hai ("on Monday morning") → chọn thì tương lai đơn "will receive".
Sau tính từ sở hữu "your" và trước liên từ "and patience" (danh từ) cần một danh từ song hành → chọn "cooperation" (sự hợp tác).

groups.passage:
ORDER CONFIRMATION
OfficePro Equipment Ltd.
104 Broadway, New York, NY

Order Number: OP-84920
Customer: Laura Chen, Operations Manager, Apex Design
Date: October 12

Items Ordered:
- 12 Ergonomic Mesh Office Chairs (Model EC-200): $2,400.00
- 6 Adjustable Standing Desks (Model SD-50): $1,800.00
Subtotal: $4,200.00
Corporate Discount (10% on orders over $3,000): -$420.00
Standard Delivery: Free
Total Paid: $3,780.00

Delivery Information:
Your order will be shipped via Metro Freight and is scheduled to arrive at your office on Thursday, October 16, between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM. An authorized representative must be present to sign the delivery manifest.

Need to reschedule?
Please notify our dispatch department at support@officepro.com at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled delivery time to avoid a rescheduling fee.

questions.content: Why was the corporate discount applied to this order?
options: The items were paid for in cash
The order was placed before October 10
questions.explanation: Trong hoá đơn ghi rõ: "Corporate Discount (10% on orders over $3,000)" → đơn hàng trên 3,000 USD được giảm giá.

questions.content: What is required at the time of delivery?
options: A signature from an authorized representative
questions.explanation: Văn bản nêu: "An authorized representative must be present to sign the delivery manifest."

questions.content: What should Ms. Chen do if she wants to change the delivery date without a penalty?
options: Email customer support at least 24 hours in advance
Return the items within 30 business days
Call the driver directly on Thursday morning
Submit a written request by postal mail
questions.explanation: Mục 'Need to reschedule?' yêu cầu: "Please notify our dispatch department at support@officepro.com at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled delivery time".
